hypothesis: First meaningful pullback after entering top-20 gainers produces executable continuation edge after reclaim above pullback-start level
mechanism: Attention-driven initial spike exhausts early buyers; pullback presents low-risk re-entry for momentum continuation
reason: No executable edge: 2702 first_entry ->1272 signals(47% rate) but expectancy net negative at 1/3/5/15/30m, 60m +0.42% overall but OOS fails train+0.66% vs test-0.14%. Segmentation shows no persistent pocket after costs (10bps/side). Kill.

hypothesis: HOD breakout (new RTH high after ≥5% gain) predicts continuation at 5m/15m horizons, segmented by time-of-day and RVOL
mechanism: HOD is a psychological level; break above it attracts breakout traders and short-covering
reason: No executable edge: 41947 HOD breakouts (≥5% gain, new RTH high, 5m dedup) but expectancy net negative at 1/3/5/15/30m, 60m gross +0.20% net 0.00% overall; train 60m net +0.08% vs test -0.20% (OOS decay). Best pocket 10-20% gain +0.28% net at 60m but small. 20%+ reverses negative. Segmentation by time shows 10:00-11:00 best but not persistent after costs. Kill.

hypothesis: Gain × volume × time-of-day interaction: early-session high-gain high-volume top gainers outperform late-session equivalents
mechanism: Morning momentum attracts more attention and institutional participation; late-day moves are lower-conviction
reason: Interaction rejected: high-volume underperforms low-volume at all horizons (h60 high 0.06% vs low 1.46%, diff -1.41%). Early (09:30-10:00) worst at h60 -0.06% vs 10:00-12:00 best +1.28%. Best cells are low/med volume mid-morning (20%+|med|10:00-12:00 h15 +0.60%, 20%+|low|10:00-12:00 h60 +2.83%) not early high-gain high-volume. Train/test top5 overlap 1/5 at 15m and 60m — no persistence. 38522 events 21d (14/7 split).

hypothesis: Micro-pullback (0.5-1%) during strong trend above VWAP produces edge on resumption
mechanism: Intra-trend pullbacks allow late momentum buyers to enter without chasing; VWAP confirms trend strength
reason: No executable edge: 20800 micro-pullback(0.5-1%)+reclaim(≤0.1% of HOD) above VWAP (close>VWAP, gain≥2%, 5m dedup) but expectancy net negative at all horizons h1-60m overall h60 gross +0.12% net -0.08%; train h60 net -0.06% vs test -0.15% (OOS decay). Best pocket 10-20% gain h30 net +0.24% (n739) h60 +0.21% (n619) and 20%+ h30 +0.76% (n138) h60 +0.63% (n96) but tiny. 09:30-10:00 h60 +0.12% net only window positive. Depth 0.5-0.7% vs 0.7-1.0% identical. VWAP filter adds no edge after costs (20bps roundtrip). Kill.

hypothesis: Rank persistence (>5 min in top-5 gainers) predicts continuation better than brief ranking spikes
mechanism: Sustained attention ranking filters one-minute noise and indicates genuine institutional/retail momentum

hypothesis: Stocks trading >8% above intraday VWAP fade over next 15–30m, with larger VWAP distance predicting larger negative forward returns.
mechanism: VWAP is intraday gravity; extreme distance reflects transient liquidity imbalance and profit-taking that reverts as price is pulled back to volume anchor
differs_from_killed: Inverts H004 (buy above VWAP micro-pullback) and H001/H002 continuation logic; tests continuous distance as mean-reversion/fade predictor rather than binary above-VWAP filter for longs
verdict: KILLED. June +0.49%/15m @20bps (tail 12%+ +3.08%, n=247) did NOT replicate: May ~0 (n=517 tail +0.13%), July negative 15m (-0.255%) with tail n=1,070 at -0.065% @20bps; monotone VWAP-distance gradient absent in July. June = small-sample luck.

hypothesis: Top gainers that consolidate in a narrow intraday range (5m high-low <40% of rolling ATR or <1% for 15m) before a breakout produce higher continuation than stocks that grind uninterrupted to HOD.
mechanism: Volatility contraction stores energy; tight consolidation builds stops above/below and allows shorts to lean in, so the subsequent break has fuel and less overextension
differs_from_killed: First precursor hypothesis — conditions on low-vol regime before move vs H001/H002/H004 which all trigger reactively after extension; tests squeeze→expansion not pullback/reclaim
verdict: killed on 2025-06 certified: contraction (15m range <1%) WORSE than grind control after costs (-0.179% vs +0.241% 60m exp_net, 20bps RT); all sub-segments negative; rolling-ATR arm untested; degenerate OOS

hypothesis: Top gainers whose cumulative dollar volume exceeds time-of-day expected volume (RVOL vs 20-day TOD baseline >1.5) outperform those with same absolute dollar volume but low RVOL over next 15–60m.
mechanism: RVOL isolates genuine attention surprise from intraday seasonality; H003's naive daily tercile mixes lunchtime lulls with opens — TOD-normalized surge signals informed flow
differs_from_killed: Fixes H003 flaw: replaces per-day dollar tercile (no TOD normalization) with RVOL surprise vs TOD baseline; tests volume acceleration not absolute level
deferred_note: RVOL baseline not yet computed — compute expected vol from trailing 20d by time_bucket before testing
verdict: RELATIVE EDGE REAL, ABSOLUTE NOT EXECUTABLE. RVOL>1.5 beats same-$-volume RVOL<1.0 by +7..+28bps @60m in 6/6 matched cells (2/2 months, ~+20bps typical); effect strongest in low/mid absolute volume (attention-surprise mechanism confirmed). But universe long-side is net-negative ~20-30bps RT, so best cells land at breakeven to -0.2%; 40bps RT all negative. Stack with H009-faithful replicated in June only. Use as selection factor; not a standalone strategy.

hypothesis: A failed breakdown that dips below prior RTH HOD or VWAP then reclaims within 5 minutes predicts continuation better than a clean HOD breakout that never failed.
mechanism: Failed breakdown hunts stops and shakes weak longs; reclaim traps shorts and confirms demand — bear trap is stronger than clean level touch where no liquidity was taken
differs_from_killed: Inverts H002 clean HOD break (close>prior HOD) by requiring prior failure below level; H001/H004 tested only successful reclaims/breaks without preceding failure — this tests false-break→reclaim edge
verdict: NOT EXECUTABLE STANDALONE; relative edge real and persistent. Trap-reclaim beats clean HOD breakout 3/3 months at every horizon (edges +13.4/+20.0/+8.5bps @30m, +21.5/+28.6/+13.7 @60m for May/June/July @20bps RT) but magnitude shrinks each month and July-only absolute net expectancy ~0 @20bps, negative @40bps; June's 10-11am concentration absent in July. Use as entry-quality filter, not a signal.

hypothesis: Stocks with large extended-hours gaps (prior close to 09:30 open >5%) that hold above the opening 5m high through 09:45 continue in gap direction during RTH, while gaps that immediately fail the opening range fade.
mechanism: Gaps reflect overnight repricing; holding opening range shows buyers defend new value (continuation), rejection signals exhaustion and gap fill
differs_from_killed: Shifts from RTH-only levels (H002 HOD, H004 VWAP) to overnight→RTH transition; conditions on premarket repricing and opening-drive hold — untested dimension (all prior start after RTH top-gainer entry)
verdict: killed on 2025-06 certified: gap-up-hold continuation positive only at n=8/n=6 (collapses -3.75% 60m); stable positive is gap-up-FAIL +0.51% 60m net 20bps (inverse of claim); gap-down segments n<=2 unusable; required $1M open-DV gate (62% of |gap|>5% universe thin/OTC); degenerate OOS (19 signal days)
